title: Rare-book-stripping monks above a strip club

tellings.quote: went to visit them at their location which was they had a chapel and it was located above a strip club in Jamaica, Queens.

plain: An author named Peter Levenda says that in the early 1970s he visited a group of monks, tied in his story to the stripping of rare books, whose chapel was "located above a strip club in Jamaica, Queens" in New York. Levenda tells it as his own experience, a glimpse of the odd fringe religious world he moved through as a young man.
